thread:
zoe (prod): heads up 3: quick feedback from CAE about the private setup wizard0network step. they asked for clearer differentiation between "network prerequisites" and "optional optimizations". thoughts?
ken (design): makes sense. propose two stacked sections: Required checks (collapsed by default) and Optional improvements (collapsed). required section should show pass/fail with clear remediation CTAs. optional can have tips with 'Try if you want lower latency' tone.
parv (eng): backend will mark each probe with "required": true/false so UI can group. note: some probes are environment-dependent (eg. NAT health) so we should include a tooltip "May not apply to your setup".
ada (a11y): grouping is good for screen reader users. use heading elements for the section titles and ensure the expand/collapse controls are buttons with aria-expanded. also include `aria-controls` linking to the content.
zoe (prod): copy question: for the required checks, should we use "Fix" or "Resolve" for the CTA? CAE preferred "Resolve" because it's less terse.
ken (design): "Resolve" reads a bit formal. maybe "Fix issue" reads clearer. but if CAE prefers "Resolve" we can use "Resolve" for required and "Try" for optional.
parv (eng): implementation detail: Resolve will open a flyout with step-by-step remediation. we'll prefill commands where possible. ensure those commands are not editable and have a copy button.
ada (a11y): copy buttons need aria-live feedback: "Snippet copied to clipboard" announced. and for the flyout, set role="dialog" and focus management: focus on the first focusable control inside and return focus to the Resolve button on close.
zoe (prod): small UX thought: when multiple required probes fail, show a summarized inline message: "3 required checks failing. Resolve now / View report" so user knows it's urgent.
ken (design): agree. visual idea: a compact banner above the step with the count and two CTAs. keep tone neutral: "Action required: 3 required checks failing".
parv (eng): caution: sometimes the failing checks are transient. let's add a gentle "Last checked Xs ago" and let users re-run. also avoid auto-scrolling the page when new failures appear.
ada (a11y): screen reader should hear the banner as an alert only when count increases; otherwise keep it polite. use aria-live="assertive" for new failure count > 0 event.
zoe (prod): another product ask: make the help copy less technical for managers. e.g., instead of "open port 443" have a short human-friendly line: "Allow HTTPS from Redwood servers" and then the advanced command in the flyout.
ken (design): we'll show both: human-friendly sentence and a collapsed "Advanced" section with commands. both visible to keyboard users.
parv (eng): secure default: do not show commands unless user expands advanced; prevents accidental changes. log when users copy advanced snippet for analytics.
infra-bot: terraform apply detected change in branch `private-setup-wizard` build #3307
ada (a11y): motion/accessibility: if we animate the success checkmark, respect prefers-reduced-motion. provide static fallback and ensure the checkmark has descriptive text for screen readers.
zoe (prod): UX polish: status pills currently use icons that are too small. increase icon size to 18px and ensure clickable targets are >= 44px.
ken (design): noted. we'll update spacing tokens. also update color palette: amber for partial, green for pass, dark red for fail. include pattern (diagonal stripes) for very small pill widths so status is visible at narrow sizes.
parv (eng): accessibility action: add `data-status` attributes for CSS hooks and `aria-label` values. also we'll persist last known state to localStorage to avoid showing "Untested" after refresh.
zoe (prod): final ask: add a short "why we check this" link next to each required check that opens a micro-tooltip with one-sentence rationale. helps with stakeholder questions.
ken (design): good idea. micro-tooltips should be accessible via keyboard (focusable) and include close on escape.
ada (a11y): confirm tooltip role and ensure it doesn't trap focus; it's informational only. use aria-describedby on the check label to link to the tooltip content when visible.
parv (eng): owners: ken -> visuals + tooltips, nada -> a11y sign-off, parv -> caching + flyouts. target: include in next sprint PRD.
zoe (prod): thanks all. closing thread. :sparkles:
